service.method: SELECT PROCESS_ID ,DESCRIPTION FROM SFRWK WHERE METHOD = SERVICE_CLASS AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND ( 1=1 AND UPPER(PROCESS_ID) LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' ) ORDER BY PROCESS_ID
